founders.heading: Built by students, for students
founders.story: We struggled to find good notes for our own exams — toppers' handwritten notes are the most valuable resource, but they're scattered everywhere. So we built a trusted marketplace for them.

items.name: Aman Singh Tomar
items.bio: Designs and builds the product experience.

items.q: Are the notes really from verified toppers?
items.a: Yes — every seller passes an academic test and uploads their marksheet, which our team reviews manually before they can publish a single page.
Payments run through Cashfree, a PCI-DSS compliant gateway. We support UPI, cards and netbanking — and we never store your payment details.
Notes open in our secure in-app viewer, watermarked with your account. This protects toppers' work from piracy while giving you unlimited reading access.

items.q: Can I sell my own notes?
items.a: If you've cracked JEE, NEET or Boards with a strong rank — absolutely. Pass the quick verification test, upload your marksheet, and start earning on every sale.
If a note is materially different from its preview and description, raise a ticket within 48 hours and we'll review it for a full refund.
